name: Atha Energy Corp.
content: Atha Energy Corp. is a mineral exploration company focused on the acquisition, exploration, and development of uranium assets in the Athabasca Basin of Saskatchewan and Alberta, Canada. The company holds the largest cumulative exploration package in the Athabasca Basin, covering over 6.4 million acres of highly prospective land. Atha Energy is dedicated to identifying and advancing high-grade uranium deposits to support the global transition toward clean energy. Through strategic acquisitions and a disciplined exploration approach, the company aims to create significant value for shareholders while contributing to the future of nuclear energy fuel supply.

Officers

Troy BoisjoliMarch 2023

Chief Executive Officer

Mr. Boisjoli has over 15 years of experience in the uranium industry. He previously served as Vice President, Operations and Project Development for NexGen Energy Ltd., where he led the development of the Rook I Project. He also held various roles at Cameco Corporation, including positions at the McArthur River and Key Lake operations.

Mike CastanhoJanuary 2023

President

Mr. Castanho is a co-founder of Atha Energy and has over 20 years of experience in the capital markets and resource sector. He has been involved in the founding and financing of several successful resource companies.

Akash PatelJanuary 2023

Chief Financial Officer

Mr. Patel has over 10 years of experience in corporate finance and accounting. He has served as a director and officer of several public companies in the resource and technology sectors.

Cliff ReveringMay 2023

Vice President, Exploration

Mr. Revering is a Professional Geoscientist with over 25 years of experience in the mining industry, with a focus on uranium exploration and development. He previously held senior roles at Cameco Corporation and SRK Consulting.

Sean HarquailJanuary 2023

Independent Director

Mr. Harquail has over 15 years of experience in the mining and finance industries. He is currently a Managing Director at a private investment firm and has served on the boards of several public companies.
